name: react-ssr
title: React (server-rendered)
description: A React Router v7 app rendered on the server: a list page with a loader, a detail page, and a form with an action. It answers at the App's own hostname.
post_deploy:
Your app is live at {{url}}

Open it and read the page source: the list is already in the HTML.
It answers at the App's own hostname only, not under a preview URL.

Then:
  1. Work on it locally:
       npm run dev
  2. Open app/routes/home.tsx. The loader reads the list, and the action handles the form.
  3. Follow the logs as requests arrive:
       wawesome logs --follow
